title: Holywell Choose Your Distance!
description:
Choose your distance!

We'll do laps around Holywell. Each lap is 3.6km and we'll loop back to the start so drop off whenever you've had enough.

Great for those of you who might want to try for a longer distance.

3.6k / 7.2k / 10.8k / 14.4k / etc.

Holywell is lovely with a bit of a slope and some nice gas lamps, but no sidewalks so bring as many lights / hi-viz things you can muster!

We'll meet at the north entrance to Holywell. If driving park on Wells Road, or along Holywell and meet at the intersection of holywell and wells road.

6-7min/km, nobody left behind
